Isaac Cohen’s ability to distill complex ad-tech workflows into efficient, scalable systems stands out. Last quarter, he spearheaded a rewrite of our campaign management API, reducing average response times by 40% while handling a 3x traffic spike. When a major client’s data pipeline failed mid-bid, he spent 18 hours debugging and rerouting requests through a temporary webhook solution, minimizing revenue loss by over $200K. His knack for anticipating edge cases—like handling third-party cookie deprecation ahead of industry deadlines—keeps our engineering team ahead of regulatory shifts.  

Isaac and I collaborated daily at AdVerve, where we navigated the chaos of scaling a mid-stage adtech startup. His calm under pressure and willingness to pair-program with juniors made him a linchpin during our pivot to programmatic ads. He’s the first to volunteer for high-impact tasks, whether refining real-time bidding logic or optimizing our internal monitoring dashboards for clarity.  

What sets Isaac apart is his relentless focus on system reliability without sacrificing developer experience. He’ll refactor legacy code to improve maintainability even if it means delaying a feature release. His curiosity drives deep dives into root causes, like tracing a 15% latency spike to a misconfigured rate-limiting strategy.  

Isaac is a dependable, high-impact engineer who balances technical rigor with business pragmatism. His work consistently aligns with our goals without needing constant oversight.  

—Alex Rivera, Senior Engineer, AdVerve Technologies  
alex@adverve.com
